notes.title: New version!!!! \o/
notes.content:
[h1][b]Reasons why there was a delay for a new update of the game. [/b][/h1]

Hello everyone! Tharlles is the developer of this game. Guys, first of all, I had a huge problem with my computer. My motherboard was defective this month, and until I found this problem, I ended up spending money on other parts such as a video card and RAM memory, but the significant change in performance was with the motherboard. It brought my computer back to normal. I'm just saying the reason for the delay in the new version I think it's important to be transparent about something you want to buy, and it's taking time to provide more content.

[b]Updates.[/b]

Implemented the third stage of the game. Where a fantasy enemy of the game environment will appear. The ogre. This character is a reference to Nordic culture, but he is an impediment to the protagonist's environment.
